source_name: National Economic Register (NER) — Ministry of Economy
rate_limits: unified company search (across emirates + free zones); login-gated; no open bulk/API; ner.economy.gov.ae NXDOMAIN
notes: Federal unified company-search layer across all emirates and free zones (Ministry of Economy). Login-gated; the dedicated host ner.economy.gov.ae does not resolve (NXDOMAIN); the service sits under economy.gov.ae. No open bulk/API. Field model from public knowledge; no values copied.

source_name: Emirate DEDs — trade-license registries (Dubai DET, Abu Dhabi ADDED, etc.)
organization: Emirate Departments of Economic Development (Dubai DET, Abu Dhabi ADDED, Sharjah SEDD, etc.)
rate_limits: per-emirate trade-license issuance + verification; WAF/login (invest.dubai.ae 403); no open bulk/API
notes: Mainland companies are licensed by the emirate-level DEDs (Dubai Department of Economy & Tourism / Invest in Dubai, Abu Dhabi ADDED via TAMM, Sharjah SEDD, etc.). Trade-license verification per emirate; WAF/login-gated; no open bulk register. Owners = personal data (PDPL). Field model from public knowledge.

organization: DIFC Registrar of Companies / ADGM Registration Authority
rate_limits: public registers but WAF/rate-limited (DIFC 429; registration.adgm.com 403) for automation
notes: DIFC and ADGM are common-law financial free zones with PUBLIC registers of entities. The ADGM public-registers page loads, but the search app (registration.adgm.com) returned 403 (WAF) and DIFC's public register returned 429 — public via browser but WAF/rate-limited for automation. No downloadable register file found. Free-zone registration numbers; currency AED/USD.

organization: Dubai Financial Market (DFM) / Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX)
rate_limits: public via browser; data feeds auth-gated (connexions.dfm.ae/feeds.dfm.ae); ADX 403 (WAF)
notes: Dubai Financial Market + Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange publish listed-company profiles, disclosures, and financial statements (public via browser). DFM is a SPA with auth-gated data feeds; ADX returned 403 (WAF). Listed companies only (e.g. Emaar Properties PJSC, Emirates NBD PJSC on DFM; First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC on ADX). Currency AED.
bayanat.ae and data.gov.ae did not resolve/respond at investigation time. No company-register dataset could be confirmed.
